caption: This drawing depicts a single object: a fireplace bellows. The bellows is primarily brown in color, with a reddish-brown and tan leather body shaped like a teardrop or heart. The edges are bordered with darker shades of brown and secured with round, metallic rivets. The main surface of the bellows features a painted decorative motif of a central reddish-brown urn or vase, containing green foliage and three flowers in shades of red and orange, with additional leafy accents in green and brown. A semicircular wreath or laurel pattern is painted below the vase. The bellows handle at the top is dark brown with a yellowish highlight, curving slightly, and has a dark brown strap attached. The air spout at the bottom of the bellows is cylindrical and tapers to a rounded end, rendered in shades of greenish-brown. The background of the drawing is light beige, and the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is typed in small black letters to the lower right of the bellows.
title: Bellows
